sentences.en: The frost did a lot of damage to the crops.
sentences.zh: 霜对农作物造成了很大的损害。

sentences.en: Frozen water is called ice; dew congealed is called frost.
sentences.zh: 水冻结成冰；露水凝结成霜。

sentences.en: Grandpa Frost has good eyesight while Santa Claus wears eyeglasses.
sentences.zh: 圣诞老人戴着眼镜，而冬爷爷视力很好。
